$comment: Listing-level corrections applied by scripts/books/import-books.mjs AFTER the automatic promo-stripping rules. Keyed by the EXACT original listing title. 'basis' explains where the correction comes from: 'listing' = the information is present in the listing itself; 'editorial' = a human/assistant correction that is NOT in the listing and therefore stays flagged for review until an Open Library match confirms it. The original title/author are always preserved in the normalized output.
